items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I remember Fats Waller, the first time I saw him, I saw the back of him

ctx.x: Well, by 1933, you had heard the people like Fats and James P. and Earl...

See, I go back early, because this is my early childhood... I always go to that...my first realization of it. I remember Fats Waller, the first time I saw him, I saw the back of him -- I saw this fat guy. And I heard it from everybody: 'Have you ever heard Fats Waller?' Well, I'm playing ball then, you know. 'Oh yeah...' One time... I'd heard so much about him and his piano playing. One day they mentioned Fats Waller... He was at some kind of special show. I saw him playing... I was really far from the keys. But…
You mean when they had the bouncing ball on the screen?
